purpose: A single reproducible, presentable synthetic engineering example; not stability-study acceptance or formal research.
temperature_interpretation: Record actual provider support; model-default behavior where unsupported, not a determinism claim.
transport_retries: Existing bounded connectors only; save all attempts and technical failures. No silent model fallback.
comparison_scope: Same requested base target model, profile limits, source, writer and shared eight-question suite; weak_first_hit uses the weak target condition and strong_rule_based uses strong, matching ordinary UI condition semantics. Strategies/conditions may supply different actual evidence. This one authored example does not establish general ranking or superiority.
reference_review_policy: Use the exact curated inventory only as a disclosed engineering-authored synthetic reference; preserve actual extractor candidates, edits, source citations and confirmation provenance. Never claim independent human approval.
output_requirements: Same frozen eight-question suite with two questions per dimension across six runs
Original automatic evaluations, per-dimension results, repetition variation
Source review findings separately from automatic grades
diagnosis_mode: Saved rule-based diagnosis via GET /diagnosis; no additional diagnostic model call.
